description: The topics trending on Threads in a country (country: two-letter code, default US). Meta has not published this API and answers it only for apps it has approved; until it approves Hermoso, the reply is Meta’s own refusal, which is about Hermoso’s app and not the user’s connection. Read-only, free.

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected
